2607.07313.title: POO-LPSP: Parallel Osprey Optimized Least Penalty-Squared Prioritization Methods for Priority Derivation in the Analytic Hierarchy Process
2607.07313.paper_summary: Pairwise comparison (PC) via pairwise reciprocal matrices (PRMs) is central to the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). Although the traditional eigenvector method is widely applied to derive priorities, its theoretical robustness in reflecting true priority vectors remains debated. Building upon a previous iteration of this study, this research develops the revised Least Penalty-Squared Prioritization (LPSP) optimization models, including the revised Least Product of Penalty and Direct Squares (LPPDS) and revised Weighted Squares (LPPWS), to minimize the revised Root Mean Penalty-Squared Variance (RMPSV) and the revised Root Mean Penalty-Weighted Square Variance (RMPSWV). However, solving these non-linear formulations is computationally complex for decision-makers. To overcome these limitations, this study proposes the Parallel Osprey Optimized Least Penalty-Squared Prioritization (POO-LPSP) method. By integrating an improved bio-inspired metaheuristic Parallel Osprey Optimization Algorithm (POOA), this framework efficiently solves complex LPSP models to minimize RMPSV and RMPSWV, thereby enhancing prioritization reliability. The practical utility and computational efficiency of the POO-LPSP method are validated through a numerical application focusing on a Generative AI (GAI) vendor selection problem. To extend, POO-LPSP can serve as a robust alternative to Saaty's Eigen system method for AHP applications.
2607.07313.paper_summary_zh: 成對比較（PC）透過成對互反矩陣（PRMs）是分析層級程序（AHP）的核心。雖然傳統的特徵向量方法被廣泛應用於推導優先級，但其在反映真實優先級向量方面的理論穩健性仍然存在爭議。在這項研究的前一個迭代的基礎上，本研究開發了修訂版的最小懲罰平方優先排序（LPSP）優化模型，包括修訂版的最小懲罰與直接平方的乘積（LPPDS）和修訂版的加權平方（LPPWS），以最小化修訂版的均方根懲罰平方方差（RMPSV）和修訂版的均方根懲罰加權平方方差（RMPSWV）。然而，解決這些非線性公式對決策者來說計算上是複雜的。為了克服這些限制，本研究提出了平行鷹鷲優化最小懲罰平方優先排序（POO-LPSP）方法。通過整合改進的生物啟發元啟發式平行鷹鷲優化算法（POOA），該框架有效地解決複雜的LPSP模型，以最小化RMPSV和RMPSWV，從而增強優先排序的可靠性。POO-LPSP方法的實用性和計算效率通過一個專注於生成式人工智慧（GAI）供應商選擇問題的數值應用得到了驗證。此外，POO-LPSP可以作為Saaty的特徵系統方法在AHP應用中的一個穩健替代方案。
2607.07313.author: Kevin Kam Fung Yuen et.al.
